answers.description: Small architecture studio working on house extensions, loft conversions and barn conversions in the Peak District and Sheffield. We draw, we handle the planning, and we stay involved until the builder leaves.

items.title: House extensions
items.body: Designs that fit how you live, drawn up to suit your home and your space.

items.title: Loft conversions
items.body: We turn lofts into rooms you will actually use, from design to finish.

items.title: Barn conversions
items.body: We handle barn conversion design from first sketch through to planning.

headline.text: We draw, we plan, we stay until the builder leaves

hero.subhead: We design house extensions, loft conversions and barn conversions in the Peak District and Sheffield, from first sketch to finished build.

benefits.heading: Why homeowners work with us
benefits.lead: We stay close to every project. You get one studio handling the drawing, the planning and the build.

items.title: Designs that fit your home
items.body: We draw up plans that suit your home and your space, not a generic layout.

items.title: Planning taken off your hands
items.body: We manage the planning process for you, so you can focus on the result rather than the paperwork.

items.title: Involved until the end
items.body: We remain part of the project right through construction, until the builder finally leaves.

items.title: Local knowledge
items.body: We work across the Peak District and Sheffield, so we know the homes and the area well.
